metric_definitions.pair_chain_iptm: off-diagonal entries of pair_chains_iptm (asymmetric; both reported)
metric_definitions.contacts: inter-chain residue pairs with CB-CB <= 8 A (CA for Gly)
metric_definitions.interface_plddt: mean pLDDT of residues in >= 1 contact
metric_definitions.iface_pae: mean of (PAE(i,j)+PAE(j,i))/2 over contact pairs, A

hit.noncognate_design: rep1 control keeps chain 1 and swaps chain 2 for a length-matched chain 2 of another candidate (Hungarian assignment); rep2 control keeps chain 2 and swaps chain 1

refutations.promiscuity: kept chain reaches ipTM >= 0.6 with a non-cognate partner
refutations.disorder_zipping: >= 50% of a chain's interface residues have pLDDT < 60 in that chain's monomer fold, or chain mean pLDDT < 60 in the complex
refutations.split_gene: MMseqs2 vs all 3,585,303 DPANN proteins: a target hit by both proteins in collinear non-overlapping segments (E <= 1e-3, each >= 50% query coverage) is a fused homolog; split-gene artefact if fused homologs occur in >= 25% as many genomes as the split block or in the same genus as a folded replicate
refutations.single_lineage: passing in one replicate only fails criterion 1
refutations.generic_adjacency: if uncalled-neighbour pairs meet criteria 1-3 as often as cognate pairs, the engine call adds nothing (class-level Fisher test)

class_comparisons: cognate vs noncognate vs uncalled vs positive: ipTM distributions (Mann-Whitney) and fraction meeting criteria 1-3 (Fisher); hit definition fixed; any relaxed bar labelled post hoc
step3_msa: hit supported if ipTM stays >= 0.75 in both replicates with the genome-paired MSA; a drop below 0.5 marks a single-sequence artefact
